'''October 2001 Smyrna tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Champion Cards and Comics, Smyrna, Georgia on 6 October 2001. It is known from Damian Loback's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3021">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-06-smyrna-ga-10-6-01d3021/ smyrna-ga-10-6-01], DeckTech (Damian "Jamintheeye" Loback, 6 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-06-smyrna-ga-10-6-01d3021/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Champion Cards and Comics, Smyrna, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
